text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-u-t-o-m-a-t-e-d s-c-r-i-p-t-s f-o-r r-e-p-e-a-t-e-d l-o-g-i-n a-t-t-e-m-p-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a s-e-r-v-e-r l-o-g o-f p-a-y-l-o-a-d r-u-n-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e b-a-s-i-c t-h-r-o-t-t-l-i-n-g r-e-v-i-e-w s-t-e-p.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r e-x-t-r-a-c-t-e-d s-e-s-s-i-o-n c-o-o-k-i-e-s f-r-o-m c-u-s-t-o-m-e-r a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a d-i-r-t-y h-t-t-p s-t-a-t-e o-n t-h-e w-o-r-k-s-t-a-t-i-o-n, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y r-e-a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-r-a-i-n-e-d g-i-f-t-c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s i-n-t-o c-a-s-h-o-u-t v-a-l-u-e s-k-u s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a p-a-t-t-e-r-n o-f h-i-g-h-f-r-e-q-u-e-n-c-y c-h-e-c-k-o-u-t s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e f-r-a-u-d-u-l-e-n-t r-u-l-e r-e-v-i-e-w s-t-e-p.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-w-a-p-p-e-d d-e-l-i-v-e-r-y a-d-d-r-e-s-s-s t-o h-i-d-d-e-n l-o-c-a-t-i-o-n-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a t-r-a-c-e a-b-l-e s-h-i-p-p-i-n-g l-a-b-e-l s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e v-i-s-u-a-l o-r-d-e-r v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r u-s-e-d b-u-i-l-t-i-n m-e-t-h-o-d-s t-o m-i-m-i-c b-r-o-w-s-e-r f-i-n-g-e-r p-r-i-n-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a t-e-s-t-r-e-p-o-r-t w-i-t-h n-o a-l-e-r-t-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e p-o-s-t-i-n-c-i-d-e n-o-r-m-a-l-i-z-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
